incomplete.description: Holes examined on this page (distinct reasons). Required; empty array when none.

coverage_complete.description: True only when incomplete is empty for examined subjects on this page.

has_more.description: More subjects may exist after this page.

exhausted.description: No further subjects after this page. MUST equal !has_more.

next_after_key.description: Resume after_key for the next page. MUST be the last examined collection key (complete row or hole), exact UTF-8. MUST be non-null iff has_more is true; MUST be null when has_more is false.
